name: Motion QA
purpose: Unified motion QA: decode and spec compliance, true-black and very-dark frames, static holds (frozen versus slow drift), repeated compositions, transition variety, loudness and silence, plus a DOM probe for text size, collisions, contrast, HUD labels, counters, card piles and repeated layouts. Findings are objective, measured or judgment; waivers need a declared intent; writes a critique pack.
capabilities: scripts/dom-probe.mjs reuses the puppeteer-core and Chrome cache shipped with the hyperframes install
checks that did not run are listed with a reason; audio-cut-alignment is not implemented

compatibility.notes: Reproduced the hand-measured defects of an archived film (font sizes matched exactly; freezes of 2.0-10.5 s quantified). Several thresholds are starting values; see the report.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Launches one headless Chrome through the hyperframes install; under the render lock.

approval_evidence: Exercised in tests/test-creative-intelligence.py (54 tests) and on three demonstration projects on the M2 host (2026-11-02). Experimental: not promoted to approved because that requires a render-host evidence trail over more than one session.
